high_level_description: The image depicts two women seated at what appears to be a political rally or event. The woman on the left is wearing a red blouse with black sleeves and has long dark hair tied back. She is holding hands with the woman on the right, who is dressed in a light-colored saree with a grey and beige pattern, and she has short, gray hair. Both women appear to be engaged in conversation or listening intently. In the background, there are several other individuals, some of whom are also seated and appear to be part of the audience or other participants in the event.
